build_aria_model: build the AriaForConditionalGeneration multimodal model combining vision tower, projector, and MoE language model
create_vision_transformer: create the AriaVisionTransformer vision encoder that processes pixel values and generates image embeddings
build_projector: build the AriaProjector module that projects ViT outputs into MoE inputs using cross-attention and feed-forward layers
load_model_weights: load weights into the Aria model using AutoWeightsLoader with HuggingFace-to-vLLM weight mapping
process_image_input: process image pixel inputs through the vision tower and projector to produce multimodal embeddings
